note: Same Landau/Borel-Caratheodory lemma, but [L] subtracts the zero sum on a disc of radius R/2 and has constant 48/R, not the zero-free form 2R log(M/|f(s0)|)/(R-r)^2.

snippet.text:
/-- **Landau's lemma.** `f` entire, `f(c) ≠ 0`, `|f| ≤ B` on `|z − c| ≤ R`, `|f(c)| < B`. For
`|z − c| ≤ R/4` with `f(z) ≠ 0`:
`|f'(z)/f(z) − Σ_{|ρ−c|<R/2} m_ρ/(z − ρ)| ≤ 48 log(B/|f(c)|)/R`. -/
theorem landau (hf : Differentiable ℂ f) (hfc : f c ≠ 0) (hR : 0 < R) {B : ℝ}
    (hB : ∀ z ∈ closedBall c R, ‖f z‖ ≤ B) (hBc : ‖f c‖ < B) {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ closedBall c (R / 4))
    (hfz : f z ≠ 0) :
    ‖logDeriv f z - ∑ u ∈ zerosIn f c R (R / 2), ((divB f c R u).toNat : ℂ) / (z - u)‖ ≤
      48 * Real.log (B / ‖f c‖) / R := by

proof_context.conclusion: Landau's lemma via Borel-Caratheodory: for entire f with |f|<=B on the disc, |f'/f(z) minus the zero sum over |rho-c|<R/2| <= 48 log(B/|f(c)|)/R for |z-c|<=R/4.
